description: This PHP source file defines the ReviewListController class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends ReviewSearchController and overrides the preRender method to set up a Vue component named 'review-list', adding date properties before rendering.

classes.name: ReviewListController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling review list views in the performance module, extending review search capabilities and rendering a Vue component.
